done_when: forge test --pytest runs the whole suite for a pyproject.toml change only when its dependency or pytest settings change, and only related tests otherwise; every uv command Forge runs uses the lockfile without rewriting it, so no Forge command leaves uv.lock changed; one command test per case; new and earlier-adopted client repos get it, with a command test for each

findings.body: The dependency projection still ignores dependency-affecting settings in `tool.uv.pip` and `tool.hatch`. For example, changing only `[tool.uv.pip] resolution = "lowest"` in a client whose test command installs dependencies with `uv pip` leaves the snapshots equal. Forge then runs related tests, or returns success without running any tests at fasttest.py:252–254, instead of running the full suite. New evidence beyond the earlier ruling: [uv documents dependency-resolution settings under tool.uv.pip](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/settings/#pip), independently of the root settings added here; the root `torch-backend` setting is also omitted. The same omission affects Hatch environment `dependencies`, `extra-dependencies`, features and dependency-group selection, plus build-target and build-hook dependencies, documented in [Hatch environment configuration](https://hatch.pypa.io/latest/config/environment/overview/) and [Hatch build configuration](https://hatch.pypa.io/latest/config/build/). These are dependency settings, rather than unrelated tool metadata. The command regression table at tests/test_pyproject_changes_keep_tests_related_and_locks_frozen.py:72–128 covers neither namespace, so all listed proofs can pass while these Done-when cases remain broken. Include these dependency inputs in the comparison and add command regression cases.
findings.title: Not done: forge test --pytest runs the whole suite for a pyproject.toml change only when its dependency or pytest settings change

why: Any pyproject.toml change makes forge test --pytest run the whole suite locally (30+ minutes holding the test slot), and uv run rewrites uv.lock back to an old cached version in older worktrees, leaving stray changes that block closes and cleanup
